premise: Bear cub wants to stay up all winter but keeps yawning; he sleeps in his den and Bird wakes him with the first spring song.
inspiration: Rip Van Winkle, turned: sleeping through is safe and cosy, and friends are waiting when you wake.
lesson: Resting is nothing to miss out on; friends will be there when you wake.
learning: Bears sleep through much of the winter in a den

en-US.title: Bear Cub Waits for Spring
en-US.text: The days were getting shorter and colder. [curious] Bear cub, aren't you going to sleep for the winter? asked Badger {badger:pulse}. Not me, said the bear cub {bear:hop}. I'm staying up to see the snow! He tried very hard. {bear:live} But he yawned, and stretched his arms up high, rubbed his eyes, patted his round tummy… and nodded off. [giggles] Badger helped him into his cosy den, and tucked dry leaves all around. [softly] Sleep well, he said. We'll wake you in spring. All winter long the snow fell, and the bear cub slept, snug and warm. Then one morning, Bird {bird:float loop 0.3} landed at the door and sang. {sfx:spring-song} Tweet, tweet, tweet! [excited] The bear cub {bear:hop x2} opened his eyes. Is it snowing yet? [laughs] No, sleepyhead, said Bird. It's spring!

es-ES.title: El osito espera la primavera
es-ES.text: Los días eran cada vez más cortos y más fríos. [curious] Osito, ¿no te vas a dormir todo el invierno?, preguntó Tejón {badger:pulse}. Yo no, dijo el osito {bear:hop}. ¡Me voy a quedar despierto para ver la nieve! Lo intentó con todas sus fuerzas. {bear:live} Pero bostezó, estiró los brazos bien alto, se frotó los ojos, se dio unas palmaditas en la barriga… y se quedó dormido. [giggles] Tejón lo ayudó a meterse en su guarida calentita, y lo arropó con hojas secas. [softly] Que duermas bien, le dijo. Te despertaremos en primavera. Todo el invierno cayó la nieve, y el osito durmió, calentito y a gusto. Hasta que una mañana, Pájaro {bird:float loop 0.3} se posó en la puerta y cantó. {sfx:spring-song} ¡Pío, pío, pío! [excited] El osito {bear:hop x2} abrió los ojos. ¿Ya está nevando? [laughs] No, dormilón, dijo Pájaro. ¡Es primavera!

spring-song.prompt: a bright little songbird singing a happy spring morning song
